positive.reason: All declared fields match the collected Item.

negative.reason: A deterministic field mismatch is decisive; no negation hides it.

boundary.reason: Minimum permitted non-empty Item and field cardinality.

empty.reason: No evidence was collected; absence is not a passing result.

permission-denied.reason: Permission denied is preserved as UNKNOWN.

error.reason: Collector ERROR is not converted to FALSE or TRUE.

not-applicable.reason: Applicability is a typed outcome, not a Boolean false.
